messages:
Iris: FYI  FlowSmith (orchestrator ISV) wants a certified LangChain/LlamaIndex adapter + a deployable "recipe" for Private deployments (VPC + KMS) bundled with NebulaHW's marketplace SKU. They also want a joint case study with an SI (ByteScale) who will do the on-prem install. Need owners and a short playbook.
Carlos: We can do a v0 adapter for FlowSmith in ~10 working days: ingest->vector-search->rerank->stream. key asks: support streaming, embeddings, and a rollout policy hook for canaries.
Mei: DevRel will own example docs + the case study draft. prefer a small POC KB and a reproducible script that works both hosted and Private.
Jordan: Marketplace/partner-ops here  marketplace listing (NebulaHW) requires publisher contract + verified deploy recipe for the Private SKU. Nebula also wants a short security blurb about KMS/HSM integration and data residency.
MarketplaceBot: Marketplace manifest checklist: 512x512 icon, 1-line tagline, description <=2000 chars, support contact, pricing SKU mapping, vendor ID, deployment recipe (for Private: infra steps + KMS instructions). Manifest due 10 business days before publish window.
OpsBot: Ops note: Private packaging needs a Helm chart + example kustomize overlay for on-prem. also a secrets doc for KMS/HSM usage and a sample KeyPolicy snippet. Ops ETA for packaging: 7 working days after adapter PR.
Iris: Owners: Adapter = @Carlos, Private recipe & Helm = @Ops (OpsBot/Charlie), Docs & case study = @Mei, Marketplace/legal = @Jordan. Carlos, can you include a rollout policy example in the adapter config?
Carlos: yes. sample invocation for demo docs:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/adapters/flowsmith/run \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \\n  -d '{"flow":"kb->rerank->summarize","source":"lindex://flowsmith-demo","stream":true,"max_tokens":180}'
```
Carlos: adapter config (will push as rwd-flowsmith-lc):
```yaml
adapter:
  name: rwd-flowsmith-lc
  batch_size: 6
  stream: true
  quant_profile: q4_0
  rollout_policy:
    type: canary
    percent: 10
    monitor: perf_and_quality
```
Mei: i'll draft a case-study outline: goal, architecture diagram (on-prem + NebulaHW), performance table, customer quote template, and a short install story for ByteScale. will need perf numbers from infra.
Jordan: legal intake opened (TKT-7233). also will need the KMS integration doc before we finalize the publisher contract.
OpsBot: Helm chart scaffold will include values for KMS provider (aws-kms, vault-hsm), node selector for NebulaHW SKU, and resource requests. sample values snippet:```yaml
replicaCount: 2
resources:
  requests:
    cpu: "8"
    memory: "32Gi"
nodeSelector:
  hw_vendor: nebulahw
kms:
  provider: vault-hsm
  key_id: "REPLACE_ME"
```
Carlos: timeline proposal: adapter PR in 9 working days, QA + smoke tests 4 days, ops packaging 6 days, perf runs 4 days, docs + manifest 5 days, legal 5 days. internal demo + case-study draft = 3w, external publish = 4w.
Iris: Perf ask: infra please run throughput and p95 on Nebula A10-equivalent nodes with quant q4_0 and also on a mixed batch/stream workload. provide tokens/sec and cost estimate per 1M tokens.
OpsBot: Scheduling perf runs now. please provide short/med/long query mixes. ETA results in 4 business days.
Mei: Marketing/DevRel ask  need a 60s demo GIF and 2 screenshots. design will work after notebook link. will draft announcement copy once perf numbers land.
Jordan: Marketplace window note: NebulaHW Marketplace vetting closes 2026-05-03 UTC. set manifest submission to 2026-04-20 to be safe.
Iris: Good. who will own announcement copy? Mei to draft, Jordan to review legal language, Iris to approve final.
Carlos: pushing PR today, will tag ops, infra, and QA. smoke tests will include rerank correctness and streaming stability.
Mei: will scaffold notebook today with a small privacy-safe KB and CLI examples for hosted vs private flows.
Jordan: linking internal policy: https://rwd.internal/partners/marketplace-private-guide (action: Jordan to update when KMS doc is attached).
Iris: we'll run 15-min sync every Tue. please react with :white_check_mark: when your item is green.
Carlos: :white_check_mark: PR draft pushed (WIP).
Mei: :eyes: notebook scaffold up, case-study outline in doc.
OpsBot: :soon: helm chart scaffolded, packaging ETA 6 days. perf jobs queued.
Jordan: :eyes: legal intake submitted (TKT-7233).
